ALRIGHT! Dicy Lore... this tale starts before I was even born, At the about half way point of my mother pregnancy they told her that it was a near certainty I would either die at birth or be born with major health problems, neither of which ended up being true. But since my family was super religious it was seen as a miracle and the preacher of my grandmothers church declared I would one day become a preacher as well. That starting point aside I was born in a middle of no where small Kentucky town but once my father passed away when I was four we ended up moving up north in the state for the big cites of the state where I've lived since. Growing up i was very smart but also very lazy LMAO. I was offered a spot in the gifted and talent program and declined it because I didn't care enough for the extra work. I started playing football in middle school but had fell out of love with it by the time I was out of high school so never bothered to play in college. Originally i went to college for accounting but hated it so I switched over to just finance. Growing up my family was really controlling so I never really got to explore myself a whole whole lot So college is by far my wild era I joined a frat (tbf it was a academic honors frat. but I mean still a frat LOL) was during college after a really horrible break up with a ex that I went on a massive like self discovery thing and ended up realizing I was very much not straight like I had thought and been taught my whole life so i came out as pan to my closer friends and also org community because I knew I would be accepted among it (this actually happened mid Snack S2). But we now find ourselves graduated and on the hunt for our first Big Boy college grad job.
